_meta.what_this_is: A tiny contract file that exists ONLY to exercise scedit code paths the real contract cannot reach yet. It is NOT a source of facts about spacecrafter and must never be read as one: every name in it is invented for the test and says so.
_meta.why_it_exists: D31 asks for the DEFAULT value of an empty value field to be shown greyed and offered to completion. At HEAD every one of the 324 argument specs in grammar/sc-grammar.json states its default as an English SENTENCE ('absent -> 0', 'absent or empty -> the next form is tried'), so there is no literal a machine may type on the author's behalf. scedit therefore arms that feature from an explicit `default_value` field, of which the real contract has none -- and this fixture has one, so the mechanism is tested rather than merely written.
